title: Workspace wall / material detail

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Examine the material translation of digital motifs because a convincing physical identity depends on edges, finish and depth.
strategic_value: Colored star layers and small cursor objects can retain Figma’s expressive character at close viewing distance.
demonstration: A close crop pairs large layered starbursts, small hand and cursor symbols, black letter fragments and the perforated wood surface.
practical_value: Inspect the relationship between flat digital motifs and dimensional fabrication.

content_islands.name: Star layers
content_islands.spec: Let a large multicolor star fill the lower foreground and a smaller lavender star sit above.

content_islands.name: Small tools
content_islands.spec: Place hand and arrow symbols between the stars.

content_islands.name: Material reference
content_islands.spec: Retain black letter fragments, panel seams and peg holes to show scale and depth.

reference_purposes.Application: The close photograph exposes materials, raised edges and overlaps in the wall installation.
